name: Luriastis T. Mikuriya
original_name: ルリアスティス・T・御厨
source: A childhood playmate of [url=/c83566]Nao's[/url] from a wealthy family they promised each other they would get married one day. Although he forgot about it she and her family have looked forward to their eventual wedding when they grow up. She arrives at the inn to fulfill their promise, while being completely unaware of [url=/c10568]Mihono's[/url] recent engagement to Nao.
